title: abelmoschus adscendens
intro: Abelmoschus adscendens, commonly known as Abelmosk, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae) native to Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Abelmosk include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Abelmosk include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
